data.narrative:
Contec is a public company trading on KOSDAQ in the Space & Aerospace sector. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable here. Peer-Median anchoring fails due to insufficient narrow-stage filtering: while 11 same-sector peers exist across the Space & Aerospace universe, fewer than 3 meet simultaneous criteria for stage, stage-adjacency, or valuation tier, making sector median unreliable. Public-Comp anchoring cannot proceed without Contec's revenue figure, which is not on file. The Space & Aerospace public median trades at 23.9x P/S across the 6-ticker reference set, but application requires disclosed revenue data absent from this dataset.

Given Contec's status as an already-public entity with $58.7M total raised, traditional venture valuation frameworks have limited applicability. A credible range cannot be synthesized from the available data. Determining fair value would require: (1) Contec's trailing or forward revenue, enabling P/S benchmarking against the 23.9x public median; (2) profitability or margin metrics for EV/EBITDA comparison; or (3) access to private transaction multiples from the identified peer set. Without these inputs, any numerical range would constitute speculation rather than analysis.
